[[File:Ayyubids AoE4.png|x22px]] {{tt|120|105 before patch 9.1.370}} seconds |Size = 5 x 5 tiles |Influence = 9 x 9 tiles }} The '''[[wikipedia:House of Wisdom|House of Wisdom]]''' is the only [[landmark]] available to the [[Abbasid Dynasty]] and [[Ayyubids]] in ''[[Age of Empires IV]]''. It can be built in the [[Dark Age (Age of Empires IV)|Dark Age]] and upgraded to provide various bonuses similar to the landmarks of other civilizations. It also generates the Golden Age [[Influence (Age of Empires IV)|influence]] area that unlocks various bonuses for each civilization. == Special ability == * [[File:AoE4 InfluenceBuff.png|22px]] '''House of Wisdom Influence''' (Influence): The House of Wisdom generates a 9 x 9 tile influence area around it. All buildings within this influence gain +5 fire armor and, except for [[Mill (Age of Empires IV)|Mills]], extend the influence area by 1 tile around their footprint. Mills extend the influence area by 2 tiles around their footprint (so [[Farm (Age of Empires IV)|Farms]] can still be built around them while fitting within the influence area). Additionally, all buildings within the influence zone (except Farms and walls) contribute towards the Golden Age bonuses of each civilization. == Gameplay == Rather than building a separate Landmark in each Age, the Abbasid Dynasty and Ayyubids upgrade their House of Wisdom with a new 'wing' instead. Each wing that is added advances the civilization to the next Age, and adds 5,000 hit points to the building itself. Adding wings costs the same as a regular Age-up, with the exception of the fourth wing, which does not have a corresponding fifth Age, but costs the same as the third wing. The time to research a wing is constant at 100 seconds for the Abbasids and {{Tt|120|96 for Advancement}} for the Ayyubids, which is much faster than the base landmark construction times (190/220/250 seconds for each Age respectively) for other civilizations except for the [[Chinese (Age of Empires IV)|Chinese]] and [[Zhu Xi's Legacy]]. This is compensated by not having any mechanism to speed up the Age-up, like other civilizations can by building their landmarks with more [[Villager (Age of Empires IV)|Villagers]]. For the Abbasid Dynasty, advancing to the next Age with the House of Wisdom grants new technologies to research (a delayed benefit) and in some cases a group of units or other immediate benefit, depending on the chosen wing. Conversely, the Ayyubids are always granted immediate benefits from each wing upon Aging up. Economic units and military units gained from Aging up have separate [[Gather Point]]s from the House of Wisdom. Economic units rally only to resources or [[Trade (Age of Empires IV)#Trade Posts|Trade Posts]], while all other Rally Point placements are for military units only. == {{4icons|Abbasid Dynasty|30}} == {{Quote|Contains civilization technology for the Abbasid Dynasty. Abbasids advance in Ages through the House of Wisdom. Construct wings to advance to the next Age and gain additional technology.}} Each constructed wing offers a different set of [[Technology (Age of Empires IV)|technologies]]. However, these technologies are also locked behind Age requirements. This means that upon ageing up to Feudal Age, the player can unlock only 1 technology; ageing up to Castle Age, the player can unlock 3 technologies (for a total of 4); and ageing up to Imperial Age, the player can unlock 5 technologies (for a total of 9). The players can still research all 12 technologies in the end by building the fourth wing in the [[Imperial Age (Age of Empires IV)|Imperial Age]], and doing so unlocks the "All the World's Knowledge" [[Achievement (Age of Empires IV)|Achievement]]. Having the Culture Wing as the first wing of choice can be helpful, since researching [[Preservation of Knowledge]] not only reduces the cost of all technologies, but also reduces the cost of adding wings (Ageing up). {| class="fandom-table" ! !{{4icons|Culture Wing|50|

The remaining wings will then increase their bonuses for the next Age selection, offering endless strategic possibilities. Some present immediate value, while others bring long-term investment opportunities. The major strength of the Ayyubids is the ability to adapt their House of Wisdom to fit their needs.}} The Ayyubids can choose the same four wings upon aging up as the Abbasids, and each wing can only be chosen a single time. However, unlike the Abbasids, the wings do not grant access to extra technologies, but rather provide one of two choices of immediate benefits that can only be obtained in the Age they are researched, and that scale with Age. For example, advancing to the Feudal Age with the Growth branch of the Economic Wing will prevent the player from obtaining the Castle Age and Imperial Age benefits of both the Growth and Industry branches of the Economic Wing. If the player subsequently advances to the Castle Age with the Master Smiths branch of the Military Wing, it will not grant the Feudal Age Blacksmith technologies for free and instantly, but rather will grant all Castle Age Blacksmith technologies for free and instantly as soon as the Feudal Age technology is researched normally. Just like the Abbasids, the Ayyubids can build the last wing once in the Imperial Age for the same cost as the third wing. It provides the same bonuses as the Imperial Age upgrade in almost every case. |} == Further statistics == {| class="wikitable" style="font-size:89%; width:100%" |- |'''Hit points''' | {{4icons|Court Architects}} (+30%) |- |'''Upgrade cost''' |{{4icons|Preservation of Knowledge}} (-20%, {{4icons|Abbasid Dynasty}} only) |- |'''Units''' |[[File:AoE4 Reinforcement.png|22px]] Reinforcements (constant automatic production of [[Desert Raider (Age of Empires IV)|Desert Raiders]], {{4icons|Ayyubids}} only) |} == Changelog == {{Note|Changelogs for individual Age-up choices are on their respective pages.}} * With the Season Two Update, Mill influence range was increased by +1 tile to allow easy building of Farms around the Mill while still connecting to the House of Wisdom influence. * With [[update 24916]], a celebratory audio notification plays whenever a new Golden Age tier is unlocked. * With the [[Update 6.0.878|Season Four Update]], the House of Wisdom is a home market destination that can be traded with. * With [[update 11.0.782]], the House of Wisdom has separate economic and military Rally Points. === {{4icons|Abbasid Dynasty|30}} === * Originally, the technologies [[Phalanx]], [[Composite Bows]], and [[Camel Handling]] were available at the House of Wisdom, not tied to any particular wing. With [[update 8324]], they were moved to other buildings. * Originally, the Age-up time for all Ages was 120 seconds. With [[patch 11009]], this was reduced to 105 seconds. With [[patch 15.3.8338]], it is 100 seconds. * With [[patch 16.2.10604]], the Trade Wing was replaced with the Administration Wing, along with new technologies. === {{4icons|Ayyubids|30}} === * Originally, the Ayyubids retained the 105 second Age-up time of the Abbasid Dynasty. With patch 9.1.370, this was increased to 120 seconds for the Ayyubids only. * Originally, the tier 2 Golden Age bonus was +50% research speed. With patch 11.1.1201, this was reduced to +25%. == Campaign version == The House of Wisdom appears as the primary landmark in the The Sultan's Ascend campaign. It behaves like the Abbasid House of Wisdom, with each Wing unlocking new technologies per Age. It has the following differences from the standard version: * The Feudal Age Economic Wing technology is [[Food Reserves]] instead of Fertile Crescent. * The Castle Age Economic Wing technology is [[Berry Cultivation]] instead of Agriculture. == Gallery == House of Wisdom Economy Wing AoE4.png|The House of Wisdom Economy Wing House of Wisdom Military Wing AoE4.png|The House of Wisdom Military Wing House of Wisdom Culture Wing AoE4.png|The House of Wisdom Culture Wing House of Wisdom Trade Wing AoE4.png|The House of Wisdom Trade or Administration Wing House of Wisdom.png|The House of Wisdom, with all Wings installed WS_abb_houseoflearning_crop.jpg|Promotional photo from game website {{Buildings List (Age of Empires IV)}} [[Category:Landmarks]] [[Category:Abbasid Dynasty]] [[Category:Ayyubids]]
